Fires on word-initial sub-word fragments / ordinary lowercase-context tokens in normally-cased prose (e.g. the "d" of "drape", "D" of "Dementing", " my", " the", ","), and is strongly suppressed by the same kind of fragment when it is part of an ALL-CAPS word (UP-DATES, EN-DS, SAN FRANCISCO, IN-CB) — i.e. it tracks case/continuation of a split word rather than meaning.
